content.title: Is SNL New Tonight, March 14, 2026? What to Know About the Host and Musical Guest
content.text: Saturday Night Live has been on a roll over the past two weeks, with debut Host Connor Storrie knocking it out of the park, and four-timer Ryan Gosling delivering fresh hits alongside the Season 51 cast.How to WatchWatch Saturday Night Live Saturdays at 11:30/10:30c on NBC and next day on Peacock.After a hilarious monologue co-written by the Project Hail Mary star himself, the March 7 episode found Gosling playing one of his classic SNL weird guys (both human wedding guest and cyclops versions) and starring in the world's most surreal Otezla commercial. To top it all of, Gosling and cast member Ashley Padilla starred in a viral sketch that had them breaking as they read lines secretly-rewritten after that night's rehearsal.So now, the question is: Is Saturday Night Live new this week? Find out below.RELATED: Watch Harry Styles' SNL Monologue and Sketches from March 14, 2026RELATED: Ashley Padilla Reacts to SNL Prank, Calls Ryan Gosling "Funniest Person on the Planet"Not only is there a new episode tonight at 11:30 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock, you likely saw the Host show up a tad early during Gosling's March 7 opening monologue…RELATED: SNL's "Hegseth Iran Presser" Cold Open Tackles Military Strikes & Government-Made MemesRELATED: Emma Stone Deserved an Award for Her Work in SNL's "The Actress"Who's hosting Saturday Night Live on March 14?Harry Styles is returning to SNL to host tonight's episode!The pop icon just released his latest album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally, on March 6. What better way to celebrate the big milestone than by pulling double duty this week on SNL? Watch the promo for this week's episode above, in which Marcello Hernández (literally) steps into Styles' shoes. And his clothes. How many times has Harry Styles hosted SNL? Twice. His first double duty episode was on November 16, 2019.Styles is making his eighth appearance on SNL overall, counting cameos like last week's and musical performances as part of One Direction alongside former Voice Coach Niall Horan.See SNL's read-through photo collection with Harry Styles here.RELATED: Ryan Gosling's Monologue with Harry Styles Broke an SNL Record Set in His Last EpisodeRELATED: Aidy Bryant Based This Iconic SNL Sketch with Harry Styles on Her Real DogWho is SNL's March 14 Musical Guest?Harry Styles.Over 50 stars have both hosted and performed in the same episode. With tonight's episode, Styles will join that very exclusive list of artists that include Lady Gaga, Paul Simon, and many others.RELATED: Every Celebrity Who Pulled SNL "Double Duty" as Host AND Musical GuestWho is the next host and musical guest of SNL?A pair of Jacks: Jack Black and Jack White!Where can I watch old episodes of SNL?Remember, if you can't watch SNL as it airs live on NBC and Peacock tonight at 11:30 p.m. ET, the episode streams next-day on Peacock.In fact, it's never been easier to catch up on old episodes of SNL — sketches and full episodes are always available on Peacock.Click Here to Stream Any Episode of Saturday Night LiveBuy official Saturday Night Live merch:
